original_target.title: Uniqueness of the closed genus-one self-shrinker in three dimensions
original_target.area: Geometric analysis and mean curvature flow

scope_comparison: Current 2606.20276v2 retains Angenent torus uniqueness and proves conditional rotational-profile comparisons. The lower-entropy genus-one shrinker result explicitly permits noncompact examples; it supplies no compact embedded torus counterexample. Uniqueness of a tangent flow also does not classify every torus.
